value.notes: Opt-out CCA generation service within Lancaster city limits; SCE remains the delivery utility.

permit_authority.notes: The city's public Accela portal is verified; the department's own website was unavailable for this review.

interconnection_url.notes: SCE's FAQ links its online interconnection system; utility approval is separate from city permitting.
